title: P27: tie token embeddings and output readout
description: P27: share head.weight with emb.weight after ordinary GPT initialization, retaining this parameter alias throughout pretraining and downstream RL/evaluation. A common representation for reading and emitting proof symbols may improve the starting policy and its adaptation under the fixed expert-iteration procedure.
hypothesis: No prior registration ties the token interface. Run 014 tied entire blocks and lost about half the unique capacity; this instead ties only the input/output symbol representation, removing 25344 parameters (0.79%) without changing hidden capacity or logical depth. Gradients from symbol consumption and prediction may reinforce a consistent representation useful for longer-proof RL transfer. They may instead interfere because reading and writing have different roles. Run 021 changed interface learning rates and produced mixed partial evidence, not a test of sharing. This intervention also initializes the readout with the embedding values instead of its independent draw; other initial parameters and the RNG state are unchanged. Only the downstream three-seed dev-transfer metric determines keep/discard.
expected_delta: Central prediction +3 to +15 dev-transfer theorems at true length >=7 versus incumbent 012 (exact mean 147.67, stored rounded mean 148), with plausible downside -40. Seeds remain 0,1,2. Identical forward matrix shapes and a 0.79% parameter reduction imply approximately unchanged throughput and per-token inference cost; expect about 3000 steps in 300 seconds. Learned generation lengths may still change runtime within the unchanged 1200-second total cap.

arch.weight_sharing: head.weight aliases emb.weight after construction; preserved in the live model during frozen RL. Reconstruct this alias before loading checkpoint state for continued tied training; ordinary fork loading preserves logits but not the parameter alias.

config.init: fork default (normal 0.02), then replace head.weight with emb.weight; no extra RNG draws and all other parameters unchanged
